mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Ag-Cu-Mn deposit in Puno, Peru (acquisition completed Nov 2025 via Sociedad Minera Berenguela S.A. and Fossores Ltd.). Updated MRE (eff. Nov 30, 2025; QP Dinara Nussipakynova, BBA; US$137.40 NSR cutoff, pit-constrained): Measured 8.49 Mt @ 101 g/t Ag, 8.97% Mn, 0.89% Cu, 0.32% Zn (27.7 Moz Ag, 0.76 Mt Mn, 166.9 Mlb Cu, 60.0 Mlb Zn); Indicated 43.06 Mt @ 68.5 g/t Ag, 5.04% Mn, 0.58% Cu, 0.33% Zn (94.9 Moz Ag, 2.17 Mt Mn, 550.2 Mlb Cu, 312.5 Mlb Zn); M+I 51.55 Mt @ 73.9 g/t Ag (122.5 Moz Ag, 2.93 Mt Mn, 717.1 Mlb Cu, 372.4 Mlb Zn); Inferred 14.33 Mt @ 47.6 g/t Ag (22.0 Moz Ag, 0.47 Mt Mn, 118.4 Mlb Cu, 80 Mlb Zn). M&I Ag +21% (21.3 Moz) vs 2023 MRE. Semi-detailed EIA renewed for 4 more years; metallurgical testwork (ore sorting, leaching, Mn sulphate crystallization) ongoing; Phase 3 drilling underway Dec 2025 (4,000 m diamond + 2,000 m RC) targeting Copper East. No reserves, no production. Also owns the Challacollo silver-gold project (Chile; 2020 technical report, exploration stage).

notes: Ticker AAG on TSX-V; OTCQX: AAGFF. FY2025 = year ended May 31, 2025 (latest annual; figures from the MD&A for six months ended Nov 30, 2025, dated Jan 29, 2026). No production, no revenue. FY2025: net loss $14,162,591 ($0.05/share); G&A $5.40M; geological exploration $3.32M; total assets $41.56M; total long-term financial liabilities $3.96M. Six months ended Nov 30, 2025: net loss $6,246,607. Company expects future financing via equity/debt/asset sales. CEO Ralph Rushton.
